data.name: Addi
data.long_meaning: From the Greek name ‘Addas’, meaning ‘to add’ or ‘to help’. In the New Testament, the name Addai appears as a variant of the name Addas, a companion of St. Thomas in the Acts of Thomas.
data.numerology_meaning: A loving, nurturing, and compassionate person. Addi will have a natural ability to heal and care for others.

in_hebrew.name: אדדי
in_hebrew.meaning: עדי הוא שם שמשמעותו עוזר או מקושט
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אדדי הוא שם עברי שמקורו בשם עדי, שפירושו עוזר או מקושט. השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב יהודים ונוצרים כאחד, ויש לו קונוטציות של עזרה והגנה. השם אדדי מופיע גם בכתבי הקודש כחלק משמות של אנשים ומקומות.

in_greek.name: Άδδι
in_greek.meaning: Το Άδδι σημαίνει βοηθός ή διακοσμημένος
in_greek.long_meaning: Το Άδδι είναι ελληνικό όνομα που προέρχεται από το εβραϊκό όνομα עדי (Addi), που σημαίνει βοηθός ή διακοσμημένος. Το όνομα αυτό χρησιμοποιήθηκε στην αρχαία Εκκλησία και είχε πνευματικές συνnotationsations, συμβολίζοντας τη βοήθεια και την προστασία του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Addi
in_latin.meaning: Addi means helper or decorated one
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Addi is derived from the Hebrew name עדי (Addi), meaning helper or decorated one. In the early Christian Church, the name was used to signify assistance and divine protection. Its usage spread across various cultures, retaining its spiritual significance.

The name is found in biblical contexts and has been used in the early Christian Church, signifying spiritual guidance and support. One prominent example is Addi ben Moshe, a Jewish biblical figure who is said to have led his people to a land flowing with milk and honey, ensuring their growth and prosperity. In Christian communities, the name Addai is associated with the spread of Christianity, as one of the disciples of St. Thomas. This name serves as a reminder of the power of adding to one's community, whether it be through helpful deeds, guidance, or the faith.

In the Bible, we see this through the story of Addai, who accompianied St. Thomas on his missionary journeys, and played a significant role in spreading the word of God. The name "Addi" also brings to mind the Greek meaning of 'to add' or 'to help'. In our own lives, we can strive to live up to this name by being helping and supportive to those around us, and by adding positivity and light to the world. The name "Addi" serves as a reminder that every little act of kindness and every small addition can make a significant impact on the people and world around us. Through the name "Addi", we are inspired to follow in the footsteps of those who have come before us, and to make a difference in our own unique way.

It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.
